reason: Chasing farmers for their APIA papers and balance sheets is exactly where my hours go, so the idea is right, but right now the only proof is one pilot in Bihor that is not finished and a founder who does this evenings and weekends. I am happy to be early, not to be the test.
objection: My clients are not stuck because they lack a link; they are stuck because they do not open the drawer. A WhatsApp reminder from a bot gets ignored the same way my secretary's calls do, and if it fails I am back to chasing plus I have a tool to explain. And 10-12 hours a week with one client every six weeks means if two things break the week before a deadline, I am in the queue.
would_change_my_mind: A phone call with the Bihor consultant after the 60 days, with the before/after numbers on days-to-complete-file, and a look at the handover document. If that shows real days saved on farmer clients, I would sign the 720 slot.
